description: How rörledningar (pipes) are labelled and drawn on VVS-ritningar. These rules govern how a takeoff engine should parse a pipe label and infer geometry.

entries.title: Pipe label composition
entries.rule_en: A pipe is labelled on the ritning with its systemtillhörighet (system designation) and its rördimension, e.g. KV-22, VS2-32, S1-160. The digit after the dash is the pipe dimension.
entries.rule_sv_source: Rörledningar betecknas på ritningar med systemtillhörighet och rördimension.

entries.title: Repetition of the label
entries.rule_en: The label is normally repeated for every individual pipe, except for circulating circuits (e.g. värmebärare or köldbärare), where one label refers to both the supply and the return pipe.
entries.rule_sv_source: Beteckningen upprepas normalt för varje enskilt rör, utom för cirkulerande kretsar, exempelvis värme- eller köldbärare, där beteckningen syftar på både framlednings- och returrör.

entries.title: Meaning of the index digit
entries.rule_en: An extra digit (index) may follow the system designation. Its meaning is defined by the ritning or the beskrivning. For KV, VV, VVC, S and D the index usually refers to the pipe material (rörmaterial), but can occasionally mean something else. For VS, KB and G the index can refer to the material but more often refers to the system: e.g. VS1 = a radiator group, VS2 = a ventilation group; KB1 = wet cooling, KB2 = dry cooling.
entries.rule_sv_source: I vissa fall finns ytterligare en siffra, exempelvis: KV1-35, VS2-40, KB2-50. Detta index kan ha olika innebörd, vilket framgår av ritningar eller beskrivningar.
entries.notes: Some designation systems are more complex and may also encode requirements on insulation and other properties. In that case there is usually a specific legend (särskild förklaring) on the ritning.

entries.title: Material, jointing and insulation come from the beskrivning
entries.rule_en: Rörmaterial, fogmetod (jointing method) and isolering (insulation) are not read from the pipe label. They are stated in the VVS-beskrivning.
entries.rule_sv_source: Rörmaterial, fogmetod, isolering etc. framgår då av VVS-beskrivningen.
entries.takeoff_implication: Quantity takeoff from a planritning alone yields length per system and dimension. Material and insulation must be joined in from the beskrivning before pricing.

entries.title: Single-line representation on planritning
entries.rule_en: Pipes on a planritning are shown as single lines (enkla linjer). Where pipes cross, the line is usually broken (avbrott på linjen).
entries.rule_sv_source: Ledningar på planritningen redovisas som enkla linjer. Vid korsande rör görs ofta avbrott på linjen.
entries.takeoff_implication: A gap in a line is a crossing indicator, not an end of pipe. Segmentation logic must reconnect across such breaks.

entries.title: What a planritning section represents
entries.rule_en: The line style on a ritning marks the position in front of or behind the theoretical section from which the view is drawn. A planritning normally shows a section at window level (fönsternivå) looking downwards, and the height of a pipe in the room is encoded in the line style.
entries.rule_sv_source: Linjers utformning på en ritning markerar läget framför eller bakom det teoretiska snitt varifrån det avbildade betraktas. Planritningar redovisar normalt ett snitt i fönsternivå sett nedåt.
